role: PortalEntry registry over the appliance config portals block

evolution.missing_field_semantics: An absent or null portals block projects the Manual factory entry without a write. PortalEntry defaults match Coronatio: description and localURL are empty strings, services is empty, type is systemd, and absent port and remoteURL have no value.

changed.description: Mutation-only result; false for an identical upsert or absent deletion

name.description: The path key is this name lowercased with every run of non-alphanumeric characters folded to one hyphen

localURL.description: Empty for an entry without a local link; otherwise a root-relative path or an http/https URL without embedded credentials

remoteURL.description: Optional remote link, with the same URL semantics as localURL

storage.shape: Object with entries array; unknown block and entry fields survive mutations except the derived status and visible fields, which are never stored
storage.legacy_read: A tiles array projects title as name, url as localURL, type link and the original port; the next effective write replaces tiles with entries

canonical_bytes: UTF-8 JSON, two-space indentation and one trailing LF. GET schema serves these exact file bytes.
